leaves.name: grossZagierModuliOptCd
leaves.doc: Gross-Zagier, Invent. Math. 84 (1986), Thm I.6.3 and Ch. V Thm 2.1, moduli form, for the strong Weil (optimal) parametrization only (phi_* onto H_1(E(C),Z), i.e. J0(N) -> E with connected kernel), on the short models in the isogeny class of C_d; y = n y_K (n != 0); positive constant forgotten (printed under either reading of the hypothesis on phi; locators UNVERIFIED)
leaves.source: Gross-Zagier, Heegner points and derivatives of L-series, Invent. Math. 84 (1986), 225-320, Thm I.6.3 (p.230 per locators.md) and Ch. V Thm 2.1 (V section 2, p.312 per locators.md); strong Weil case

leaves.name: strongWeilOptimalCd
leaves.doc: The strong Weil curve E' of the newform f of C_d, as a short model over Q with a_n(E') = a_n(f), has period lattice c Lambda_f, c in Q (Eichler-Shimura optimal quotient + rational Manin constant + short model; analytic form, composite)
leaves.source: Shimura 1971, Thm 7.14 and section 7.5; Diamond-Shurman section 6.6; Manin 1972; Silverman AEC III.1 (all UNVERIFIED)

leaves.name: analyticIsogenyRational
leaves.doc: For elliptic E, E'/Q with period lattices L, L' and mu in Q^x with mu L in L', the isogeny z -> mu z maps E(K) into E'(K) for every number field K in C (isogeny over C by its multiplier; defined over Q since psi^* omega' = mu omega; composite only because Mathlib has no isogenies)
leaves.source: Silverman AEC Thm VI.4.1, Prop. VI.3.6, Thm III.5.2, Cor. III.5.3 (UNVERIFIED numbers)
